indicator_name: Housing price indices (new housing, resale apartments, rent) by city, monthly
description: Индексы цен на рынке жилья (новое жильё, перепродажа квартир, аренда) по городам, помесячно
unit: % (previous month = 100 or same month a year earlier = 100)
methodology: Taldau 703083 «Индексы цен на рынке жилья», period 4 (month). The index is published for cities, not oblasts: the region column carries the code of the city's region (AST, ALA, SHM for the three cities of republican status; for the others the oblast whose centre it is -- AKM = Кокшетау, AKT = Актобе, ALM = Конаев, ATY = Атырау, ZKO = Уральск, ZHM = Тараз, ZHT = Талдыкорган, KRG = Караганда, KST = Костанай, KZL = Кызылорда, MNG = Актау, PVL = Павлодар, SKO = Петропавловск, TRK = Туркестан, VKO = Усть-Каменогорск, ABY = Семей, ULT = Жезказган). NEW and RESALE apartments from 2015-01 (before that BNS published «new housing» and «resale housing» as wider series, not kept), RENT from 2012-01. National 2026-08: NEW.MOM 100.6, NEW.YOY 113.1, RESALE.MOM 100.8, RENT.MOM 104.2. config/sources.yaml had HOUSING_PRICE_INDEX as frozen at 2020: only the quarterly period (5) is; the monthly one is current.
